items.body: There’s a whole mess of shows coming up in Vancouver, on bills featuring a fine mix of international acts and locals, some of whom we’ve seen before, and some new to our eyes. It’s a fine reminder that we’re living through a pretty healthy era for music under the umbrella of Our Thing, and while there’s no doubt a million things going on that are making touring very difficult (see Bragolin having to cancel all their US dates last week), we’re eating pretty good. Of course it’s not guaranteed to stay that way, so if you have the opportunity to go see some touring or local acts in your hometown, buy a ticket, grab some merch, try and keep the touring eco-system alive so we can all benefit from it. This pic is This pic is This pic is of Tronik (Youth) Datura Inoxia & Valanaïs, “Désir et Distance” Heavy, heavy TBM kicks and metallic programming run through the new collaborative EP from Datura Inoxia. Appearing on Ratflak, the same brutalist label which brought us the recent Blokkontroll LP, it’s a much rougher and more lo-fi version of the style the Mexican duo plies than that we associate with Berlin, but they’re drawing international producers into their grinding lockstep, including this gnarly looper done in concert with French producer Valanaïs. Datura Inoxia – Control-Represión by Datura Inoxia Wants, “Bitter Shape” Last year’s In Plain Sight was a real leap forward compositionally for Calgarian melodic new wave crooners Wants, and so we’re happy to get a sense of their next moves with a new single. Jeebs Nabil’s engrossing, winsome vocals smoothly weave through bouncy but spiky synth and guitar leads, with some raw Canadian anthemics bringing the likes of Spoons to mind. Bitter Shape by Wants Neuroticfish, “Eisbär” Neuroticfish covering Grauzone? Hell fuckin’ yeah. We’re unapologetic fans of both projects, and hearing the strong pop instincts of Neuroticfish meet the classic NDW sound of “Eisbär” is lovely. The track is taken from a compilation benefiting The White Rose Foundation, who do important educational work regarding the dangers of fascism, and our responsibility to pushing back against it. The compilation hits the streets November 6th and also features covers of welle classics from (*deep breath*) Stabbing Westward, Caustic, Leæther Strip, Nouvelle Vague, Modern English, EMF (!), The Dead Milkmen (!!), and John Fucking Carpenter (!!!). We Will Not Be Silent / Wir Schweigen Nicht – A White Rose / Weiße Rose Benefit by Neuroticfish Tronik Youth, “Touch Me, I’m Sick” Okay fine, so the italo-body music thing never quite took off the way we were hoping, it seems just as the whole thing was really starting to cook, many of the major producers veered off into NRG and other revivalist dance styles, which has a sort of historic symmetry to it at least. With that said, you still get some bangers that inhabit that not-quite new beat sound, like say this new one from London’s Tronik Youth, which has all the gnarly, mechanized funk and ominours textures you could want, while still being a righteous dancefloor heater. Touch Me I'm Sick by Tronik Youth Unconscious, “Tutto è una copia” There’s solid and unpretentious dark electro/EBM to be found on the latest single on X-IMG from the always impossible to google Italian producer Unconscious. The throwback production and slowly filtering pads feel like a nice mix of Xorcist and any number of Carpenter scores you might care to name. Also, check the B-side if you’re as much of a fan of Jesse “The Body” Ventura’s conspiracy rhetoric as we are. Cold Hearts by Unconscious Stuka, “Travelling Across Obscure Dimensions” Holy shit, what the hell is this? Best description we can come up with is baroque synthpunk about Warhammer 40k, but even that doesn’t quite encapsulate things. You’ve got the dungeon synth style medieval arrangement, and bellowed/screeched vocals paired with traditional folk singing. Even as total Games Workshop dilletantes, we have some working knowledge of the Imperium’s vast lore, but not enough to decypher this madness. Just a blast of unexpected weirdness, in the best way. Travelling Across Obscure Dimensions by STUKA The post Tracks: September 14th, 2026 appeared first on I Die: You Die.

items.body: Band: Mastodon | Album: Marrow Deep | Genre: Progressive metal | Year: 2026 From: Atlanta, USA | Label: Loma Vista Bandcamp Mastodon is a trailblazing band in the realm of modern metal. As it stands, prog-sludge is one of the most popular varieties of progressive metal, at least by the sheer number of bands playing in that style, and much of that popularity can surely be attributed to these Atlantans. In revisiting their discography prior to writing this review, I noticed something of a parallel to Metallica’s career trajectory. Both bands started off with four absolutely stunning albums. This phase of work was then followed by a shift toward more radio-friendly sounds. (Obviously, The Hunter was nowhere near the success that Metallica’s self-titled was, but there are still overarching similarities.) Metallica’s subsequent records have ranged from middling (Death Magnetic, Hardwired), to awful (Reload, St. Anger), to downright baffling (Lulu). Mastodon, meanwhile, has been more consistent (and simply better, to be frank), but their output since the masterpiece that is Crack the Skye has oscillated boring-to-okay. Marrow Deep, the group’s ninth LP, comes at a time of major change for the band. It follows five years after their last album, the perfectly fine but overlong Hushed & Grim. It’s also their first release since the death of guitarist-vocalist Brent Hinds, following his messy firing from the band. Longtime touring keyboardist João Nogueira has also joined the band, officially making Mastodon a quintet, alongside new guitarist Nick Johnston. The album opens with “Barbarians Blood”, where twisting guitar lines lead a stomping rhythm in its opening moments. There are more restrained passages, where guitars skitter about and keyboards add an eerie atmosphere. Additional flavors are drawn from sources as disparate as punk and jazz. Troy Sanders and Brann Dailor trade lead vocals, but this song gels beautifully. “Poisonous Weapons” continues on in a similar vein, with perhaps a more psychedelic atmosphere. I love the integration of keys into Mastodon’s sound. It makes everything feel so lush and rich. Not that they necessarily struggled on that front previously, but it’s an exciting new variation. Contrasts in tempo and intensity continue on “Your Ghost Again”. Brann’s vocals, in particular, soar and feel majestic atop the swirling instrumental backdrop. “Snakes for Dinner” calls back to Mastodon’s earliest releases with its raw energy and powerful groove, while the soaring chorus pulls in their best moments from albums like Once More Round the Sun. The synth solo is a ton of fun, too, and it’s exciting to hear keys play more than a supporting role for this band. “Out Like a Lamb” has a more restrained opening. It’s not a gentle song, but the riffs are more controlled, and the drumming is more tight than propulsive. Keyboard embellishments add some fun texture, and in the moments where the band does let loose, twangy clean guitar notes cut through for some fun, subtle contrast. By its end, this song begins feeling a little long, despite all its good qualities. Clean guitar and tinkling synths provide a mellow and rather pretty opening to “In the Ruins”. Even when the distorted guitar comes in, it’s more scratchy than blistering, lending a certain antique rustiness that fits the title well.That is, at least until guitars like machine guns burst in and the song launches off at a gallop. Despite having a lot of good elements, this song doesn’t quite come together in the same way as the preceding cuts. It’s all solid music, but things here just don’t quite fit together. The opening of “They’re Coming for You” features some of the clearest classic prog influence on the record. Speedy, technical instrumental lines swirl around each other, and the combination of metal with organ and electric piano remind me of some of Opeth’s work. In fact, this is a very Opeth-y song overall, with its gothic-tinged verses and gentle moments of contrast. It’s around this point in the album that things started running together a bit for me. “Golden Spires” is a solid cut, if not exactly distinct in the context of the record. “Moth and Bone” has a lovely gentle intro, with a more typically Mastodon-y second half. And “A Vampire’s Demeanor” is fairly straightforward, featuring some spookier, Opeth-y elements. None of these songs are bad, but they’re not exactly essential, either. Marrow Deep ends on its two longest songs. “The Vanishing” begins as a quiet, restrained composition. Effects-laden vocals, wiry guitars, and enveloping keyboard tones evoke a dreamy atmosphere. The song’s climax is a powerful passage, with passionate screams and blistering guitar. The album then ends with “The Three Fates”. Mastodon incorporates some alt-rock influence on this cut, especially in the vocal melodies. The midsection features narration over an ominous backing, and it’s mostly a success. Narration is tough to pull off well, but the end result here isn’t too distracting. What is distracting, though, is the jazzy instrumental noodling that follows. A bit of indulgence would have been fine, but this particular passage absolutely overstayed its welcome. Once they ditch the jazz, though, the song ends on a strong instrumental jam. Marrow Deep is Mastodon’s best record since Crack the Skye. The riffs are energetic and vital, with a lot of power and urgency behind them. The addition of a keyboardist has brought new depth to their sound, and the compositions are overall quite strong. It’s not a perfect record, mind you. It is longer than it needs to be, and the band could have taken a scalpel to some of the second half. Despite these gripes, I like what I hear, and it’s good to hear Mastodon back in peak form. Score: 80/100
items._genre: progressive metal / sludge metal / psychedelic metal
items._cn_summary: Mastodon第九张录音室专辑，经历吉他手Brent Hinds去世与乐队重组后，由新成员键盘手João Nogueira和吉他手Nick Johnston加入，首次以五人编制录制。乐评将乐队发展轨迹与Metallica类比，指出在《Crack the Skye》之后作品质量有所下滑。专辑延续前卫金属与sludge的混合路线，吉他riff与键盘交织，营造层次丰富的编曲。Troy Sanders与Brann Dailor交替主唱，曲目涉及从朋克到爵士的元素引入。键盘的加入被乐评视为重要变化，使整体音色更加饱满。专辑由Loma Vista厂牌发行，整体被定位为乐队在重大变革后的一次稳定但非突破性的回归。

items.body: ８月の短評 Text by 瀬戸井厚子 (Atsuko Setoy) ♪東京混声合唱団特別定期演奏会 林光メモリアル 東混 八月のまつり 47 The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo PCT Special Regular Concert Tokon August Festival 47 ~ Memorial of HAYASHI Hikaru ~ 2026年8月8日 第一生命ホール 2026/8/8 Dai-ichi Seimei Hall 〔出演〕 角田鋼亮（指揮） 寺嶋陸也（ピアノ） 近藤 薫（ヴァイオリン） 東京混声合唱団（合唱） 〔曲目〕 林 光（詩：原民喜)：混声合唱のための《原爆小景》 水ヲ下サイ (1958)／日ノ暮レチカク (1971)／夜 (1971)／永遠（とわ）のみどり (2001) 林光：混声合唱のための《うた・ねがい・明日ともなれば》より 〈うた〉［ヴァイオリン助奏付版］作詩：佐藤信／〈ねがい〉作詩：佐藤信／〈明日ともなれば〉作詩：F. G. ロルカ 訳詩：長谷川四郎 混声合唱による《日本抒情歌曲集》より 編曲：林 光 〈箱根八里〉〈椰子の実〉〈中国地方の子守歌〉〈叱られて〉〈浜辺の歌〉 A. シェーンベルク：《Friede auf Erden》 (地には平和), Op. 13 R. V. ウィリアムズ：ヴァイオリンとピアノと合唱のための《Serenade to Music》（音楽のためのセレナード） 編曲：角田鋼亮 (アンコール)————- 作詩・作曲：宮沢賢治／編曲：林 光「星めぐりのうた」 毎年8月開催の「東混 八月のまつり」、このところずっとご無沙汰してしまっていたが、47回目となった今年、ようやく再会できた。 《原爆小景》の第1曲〈水ヲ下サイ〉を聴いていると、やはり胸が苦しくなってくる。もちろん、それは予期したことでそれなりの覚悟をして席に着いているのだが。第２曲〈日ノ暮レチカク〉の、しずかに繰り返されることばがしずかに耳を打ってくる力はつよい。第３曲〈夜〉の複雑な響きに耳を随順させ、第4曲〈永遠（とわ）のみどり〉の響き合う声の美しさにようやく胸がほぐれていく。聴き手にとって厳しい作品を聴くことは大切だ、と改めて思う。 《うた・ねがい・明日ともなれば》では、東混の各パートの声質の佳さをヴァイオリンの音色とともに堪能。《日本抒情歌曲集》よりでは各曲があまりに懐かしくてついつい心の裡で唱和せずにはいられず、ひたすら聴くことに集中、はできなくなってしまうのが申し訳ないような気がしてきた。 シェーンベルクの《地には平和》は初めて聴く作品で、居住まいを正して傾聴。この内容をしっかり受け取ることがなんとかできたか、と思う。指揮者角田氏の編曲によるウィリアムズのセレナードは、まさしく一期一会と思い、全身を受容体にするつもりで音に浸った。 そして、筆者にとって最高の贈り物となったのがこの日のアンコール。幾度となく聞いてきたし時に口ずさむこともある「星めぐりのうた」に、これほどの（「美」の）力・可能性があったとは、知らなかった。寺嶋氏のピアノが星たちのあいだにすずやかな導きのすじを曳いてゆくよう。星たちは群れつつもひとつひとつが透きとおったきらめきを放ち、しかもそれが溶け合う。あまりの〈うつくしさ〉にほとんど気を喪いそうになった。この体感、一生だいじにします。ありがとう！ (2026/9/15)

items._cn_summary: 这篇乐评记录了东京混声合唱团第47届"八月的まつり"特别定期演奏会，以已故作曲家林光为核心，呈现了一场以合唱为主的纪念音乐会。上半场以林光作品为主轴，包括基于原民喜诗歌的《原爆小景》四首连作，以及混声合唱组曲《うた・ねがい・明日ともなれば》，后者以佐藤信与洛尔卡的诗作为底，融合小提琴助奏。下半场转向经典合唱文献，包括林光改编的日本抒情歌曲集选曲、勋伯格的《地には平和》以及威廉斯的《音乐のためのセレナード》改编版。评论者对《原爆小景》的情感冲击力和《星めぐりのうた》作为安可曲的钢琴与合唱交织效果留下深刻印象。全场曲目涵盖现代合唱作品、日本艺术歌曲改编及二十世纪合唱经典，展现了日本合唱音乐传统的深厚底蕴与当代诠释。

items.body: Industrial group SPK, performing under the name The SPKtR, tours Europe from 7 November to 6 December 2026, with dates across 12 countries: Poland, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, Germany, Hungary, Croatia, Slovenia, Italy, the Netherlands, Belgium and Greece. The run includes appearances at the Wrocław Industrial Festival, the XXII Congresso Post Industriale and BIMFEST. SPK is fronted by founding member and film composer Graeme Revell, joined by his son Robert J. Revell. Ticket details are handled by the individual venues and festivals. The tour opens at the Wrocław Industrial Festival in Poland on 7 November, then moves through Scandinavia, Austria and Germany, with festival stops at the XXII Congresso Post Industriale in Pordenone, Italy, on 28 November and at BIMFEST in Sint-Niklaas, Belgium, on 5 December, before closing in Athens on 6 December. Tour dates for The SPKtR 7 November – Wrocław, Poland – Stary Klasztor, Wrocław Industrial Festival 10 November – Copenhagen, Denmark – Loppen 12 November – Gothenburg, Sweden – Monument 031 13 November – Stockholm, Sweden – Nalen, Klubb Död 16 November – Vienna, Austria – Viper Room, Liccht 17 November – Leipzig, Germany – Hellraiser 21 November – Budapest, Hungary – S1 Beer Factory 22 November – Zagreb, Croatia – Boogaloo 23 November – Kranj, Slovenia – TrainStation SubArt 28 November – Pordenone, Italy – Capitol, XXII Congresso Post Industriale 1 December – Augsburg, Germany – Rockfabrik 2 December – Berlin, Germany – Urban Spree 3 December – Utrecht, Netherlands – De Helling 5 December – Sint-Niklaas, Belgium – De Casino, BIMFEST 6 December – Athens, Greece – Black Temple About SPK and The SPKtR SPK formed in Sydney, Australia, in 1978 around New Zealand-born Graeme Revell and Neil Hill, taking its name from Sozialistisches Patientenkollektiv, a German radical-patients’ collective. The debut album, “Information Overload Unit”, followed in 1981, credited to Operator (Revell) on synthesizers, rhythms, treatments and vocals, Mike Wilkins on guitar, bass and tapes, Tone Generator (Dominic Guerin) on synthesizers and treatments, and Mr Clean (Ashley Revell) as technician. “Leichenschrei” followed in 1982 on Thermidor Records in the United States and in 1983 on the band’s own Side Effekts label in the United Kingdom. Sinan Leong joined on lead vocals in 1983, and the group moved toward a more commercial industrial dance sound on the single “Junk Funk” and the album “Machine Age Voodoo” (1984). SPK disbanded in 1988. Graeme Revell went on to a career as a film and video-game composer, scoring titles including “The Crow”, “The Craft”, “From Dusk Till Dawn”, “Sin City”, “Blow” and “Dune”, and contributing to the “Call of Duty” franchise. In 2025 he reactivated SPK for its first live shows in almost four decades, performing in Europe with his son Robert. The pair released the single “The Last of Men” in March 2026 under the name The SPKtR, its first new material in close to forty years, and made their live debut as The SPKtR at Wave-Gotik-Treffen in Leipzig in May 2026. Robert J. Revell also released his own album, “Torn Remnants of Nobility”, in November 2025. The November-December 2026 European tour follows that live debut and the “The Last of Men” release.
items._cn_summary: 本文为Side-Line发布的巡演新闻稿，报道工业先驱团体SPK以The SPKtR之名于2026年11月至12月进行12国欧洲巡演的消息。文章罗列了各场次的演出场地与日期，包括Wrocław工业音乐节、意大利Pordenone的后工业大会及比利时BIMFEST等，并简述了乐队历史：从1978年悉尼成军，到首张专辑《Information Overload Unit》，再到1984年向商业化工业舞曲方向转向《Machine Age Voodoo》，最终1988年解散。核心成员Graeme Revell此后转向影视配乐领域。文章以事实陈述为主，未涉及新专辑的音乐分析或艺术评论，属于资讯类而非乐评类文本。

items.body: Orquídeas em Prosa, the harsh EBM and dark electro project from João Pessoa, Brazil, releases its new single “Lady Death” on September 18, 2026, on Bandcamp. The track marks the project’s expansion into a duo, with Tony joining founder Soturna Cröstä, and features backing vocals from Luiza “Lizard” Marculino. Lady Death by Orquídeas em Prosa ‘Lady Death’ pushes the bass toward German aggrotech Soturna Cröstä handles vocals, synths, drums and bass on “Lady Death”, with Tony credited for the lyrics. The track was recorded, mixed and mastered by Soturna Cröstä at Carmesim HomeStudio, with Luiza “Lizard” Marculino’s backing vocals recorded separately. Orquídeas em Prosa describes the single as pushing the bass further forward than on earlier releases, in the style of German aggrotech, layered under the project’s usual mix of harsh EBM and dark electro. “Lady Death” is also available to stream on Soundcloud. Orquídeas em Prosa’s music continues to explore the darker edges of technological progress through an anarchist, cyberpunk lens, alongside existential crises, warfare and revolution. The project remains entirely self-produced, with Soturna Cröstä handling recording and mixing and cover art supplied by visual artist reptilian.creates. A second single, “Beijo Nuclear”, is scheduled for October 16, 2026. It is currently available to preview on Soundcloud ahead of a wider release. About Orquídeas em Prosa Orquídeas em Prosa is a harsh EBM and dark electro project from João Pessoa, Brazil, started by Soturna Cröstä. The project released its self-titled debut EP on February 3, 2026, a three-track collection recorded solo by Soturna Cröstä at Carmesim Home Studio, with cover art by reptilian_draw. A second EP, “Ilegalismo Electro”, followed on July 17, 2026, again written, performed and produced solely by Soturna Cröstä. For “Lady Death”, Orquídeas em Prosa became a duo with the addition of Tony on lyrics, alongside a guest vocal credit for Luiza “Lizard” Marculino. The project describes its sound as harsh EBM and dark electro filtered through an anarchist, cyberpunk lens, addressing technological progress, existential crises, warfare and revolution, and operates on a DIY basis, self-producing its recordings and artwork. Orquídeas em Prosa is active on Instagram and posts its catalog, including its self-titled EP and “Ilegalismo Electro”, on Bandcamp.
items._cn_summary: 来自巴西若昂佩索阿的Orquídeas em Prosa以双人阵容发布新单曲《Lady Death》，延续其粗糙EBM与暗电子路线，核心制作仍由创始人Soturna Cröstä独立完成，新成员Tony负责歌词创作，Luiza "Lizard" Marculino参与和声录制。制作在自家Carmesim HomeStudio完成，采用DIY模式，封面由视觉艺术家reptilian.creates操刀。音乐上，低频被推向更靠前的位置，融入德式aggrotech的元素，叠加于原有的暗电子基底之上，主题围绕技术进步的无政府赛博朋克视角展开，涉及存在主义危机、战争与革命等议题。整体制作保持了独立地下厂牌的自给自足风格，但文章内容更接近新闻发布稿，对音乐细节的评论较为有限。

items.body: French post-industrial project Dernière Volonté releases its new album, “Cendre”, on 25 September 2026, in digipak CD, black vinyl and a limited edition of 250 copies on translucent crystal-blue vinyl. “Cendre” returns to the dense, nocturnal and melancholic atmosphere of Dernière Volonté’s earliest work, revisiting the industrial and dark ambient tone the project carried before its shift toward song-based writing on “Les Blessures de l’Ombre” in 2003 and “Devant le Miroir” in 2006. The twelve tracks are “Harmonies”, “Vanités”, “Maudits”, “Mandoline”, “L’Âne et le Roi”, “Ombres”, “Des Questions”, “Contre Jour”, “Les Jets de Pierres”, “Plus j’y pense”, “Les Jardins de Tannhäuser” and “Célébration (bien à toi)”. The crystal-blue vinyl edition comes with a printed innersleeve and a download code, while the CD edition ships in a 16-page booklet. “L’Âne et le Roi” is the second track shared ahead of the album, following “Célébration (à toi…)”. Both tracks carry forward the martial rhythms, electronics and voice that have defined the project’s sound since the 1990s, applied here to the darker, sparer arrangements of Dernière Volonté’s formative albums. Dernière Volonté’s extended back catalogue remains available alongside the new album, including “Cristal”, “Commémoration”, “Devant le Miroir”, “Frontière”, “Immortel”, “Le Feu Sacré”, “Mon Meilleur Ennemi”, “Ne Te Retourne Pas” and “Prie pour Moi”. About Dernière Volonté Dernière Volonté is the project of French musician Geoffroy Delacroix, known publicly as Geoffroy D., formed in the mid-1990s. The project’s debut release, “Obéir et Mourir”, arrived in 1998 as a limited cassette rooted in martial industrial and dark ambient, built on militaristic rhythms, historical samples and sparse vocals. “Le Feu Sacré” followed in 2001, still within that early industrial and dark ambient mode. Dernière Volonté’s sound changed direction with “Les Blessures de l’Ombre” in 2003, which applied the project’s martial rhythms to verse-chorus song structures and pop melodies for the first time. “Devant le Miroir” continued that shift in 2006, combining drums, synthesizers and dark textures with more intimate melodies. Geoffroy Delacroix expanded his output in 2008 with Position Parallèle, an electronic side project with Pierre Pi mixing EBM and minimal wave, which has released five studio albums to date including “Néons Blancs” (2013), “En Garde à Vue” (2017) and “Aiguille à Découdre” (2024). Dernière Volonté’s own discography continued with “Immortel” (2010), “Mon Meilleur Ennemi” (2012), “Prie pour Moi” (2016), “Frontière” (2019) and “Cristal” (2022). With “Cendre”, the project returns to the darker, more atmospheric register of its first records while keeping the melodic voice it built up over three decades.
items._cn_summary: 法国后工业计划Dernière Volonté的新专辑《Cendre》定于2026年9月发行，回归项目早年的密集、阴郁、忧郁气质。十二首曲目延续自1990年代以来的军鼓节奏、电子声响与人声元素，但编曲更趋稀疏与黑暗，呼应1998年首作《Obéir et Mourir》及2001年《Le Feu Sacré》时期的工业与暗氛围根基，与2003年后转向歌曲结构的作品形成对照。文章同时梳理了项目主脑Geoffroy Delacroix从纯器乐工业暗氛围、经旋律化转型，到2008年与Pierre Pi成立的EBM与minimal wave侧支Position Parallèle的完整脉络。文末附有曲目列表、发行格式及过往专辑目录，整体为新闻发布性质的信息整理，而非深入乐评。

items.body: Swiss electronic musician Carlos Perón and German industrial project Melting Rust Opera released their debut full-length collaboration, “Ultra Haunted Overdrive”, on 7 August 2026 through Dark Daze Music. The ten-track album follows two prior joint singles, “Start Again” and “I’m a Ghost”, and gathers a further eight tracks the pair produced over roughly a year of work. Perón produced the album’s tracks, while Melting Rust Opera’s Stefan Bahners handles vocals and lyrics throughout. “Ultra Haunted Overdrive” runs just under 43 minutes and opens with “Quick and Dirty”, followed by “I’m a Ghost”, “An Other Crime”, “Get the Night Out of Your Head”, “Clean Up”, “It’s Not OK”, “The Disasters We Face”, “I Will Adore You”, “Start Again” and the closing “One Star”. The record brings an industrial rock sound that mixes aggressive guitar structures with electronic production and noise elements, moving between brutal and melancholic registers across its ten tracks. The two singles carried over from earlier releases were both already covered on Side-Line: “I’m a Ghost” appeared as a standalone single on 10 December 2025, and “Start Again”, produced by Perón with vocals and lyrics from Bahners, opened the collaboration on 2 May 2025. A third advance track, “An Other Crime”, followed as a single on 13 March 2026 before landing on the album. Carlos Perón and Melting Rust Opera’s collaboration history Perón and Melting Rust Opera had already worked together before their first joint single. Perón contributed to “Manipuliert – Carlos Peròn Trümmer Mischung” on Melting Rust Opera’s 2023 EP “Neue Trümmer”, and mastered the band’s 2024 album “The Power Of I Don’t Care”, also released on Dark Daze Music. “Ultra Haunted Overdrive” is the first release credited jointly to both acts as a full-length collaboration. About Carlos Perón Carlos Perón is a Swiss electronic musician from Zurich, one of the three founding members of the legendary Swiss synth-pop trio Yello, formed with Boris Blank and Dieter Meier in 1979. He left the group in 1983 to pursue a solo career spanning electronic experiments, film soundtracks and conceptual releases on labels including Ralph Records, Dark Daze Music and SPV. Early solo works include “Impersonator” (1981) and the soundtrack “Die Schwarze Spinne” (1983), followed by a series of conceptual releases through the 1990s and 2000s. Perón founded the Eisenberg label in the late 1980s and launched the “Der Eisenberg Sampler” compilation series, later revived with Norwegian label Sub Culture Records. He also works as a producer and mastering engineer, having worked with acts including Punch ‘n’ Judy and Piston Damp, and with Beborn Beton in Switzerland and Cologne. Through 2025 and into 2026, Perón has released a run of metal-leaning singles under his Dark Daze Music imprint, alongside his ongoing work with Melting Rust Opera. About Melting Rust Opera Melting Rust Opera is an experimental industrial and metal project based in Rheinbach, Germany, centered on musician and producer Stefan Bahners, with Wilson May contributing live percussion. The project emerged in late 2016 or early 2017 after Bahners’ earlier project, Die Rostigen Löffel, went on hiatus, and combines industrial, avant-garde and noise elements with rock and metal structures. Melting Rust Opera’s discography includes the full-lengths “The Rise and Fall of Flesh Wire” (2021) and “different places” (2022), the EP “Neue Trümmer” and the release “Broken Zukunft” in 2023, and “The Power Of I Don’t Care” (2024). The project has also released remix work, including a version of Laibach’s “Bossanova” (2017), two remixes for Dagobert’s single “Das Mädchen aus der schönen Welt”, a remix of Anne Clark’s “Orange Suns” for “Synaesthesia – Classics Reworked”, and a remix of A Place To Bury Strangers’ “I’m Hurt” for “See Through You: Rerealized”. “Ultra Haunted Overdrive” extends the project’s ongoing work with Perón into its first joint album.
items._cn_summary: 这篇文章报道了瑞士电子音乐人Carlos Perón与德国工业项目Melting Rust Opera的首张合作全长专辑。专辑由Perón制作，Stefan Bahners负责人声与歌词，包含十首曲目，融合了工业摇滚的攻击性吉他结构、电子制作与噪音元素，在暴烈与忧郁之间游走。Perón曾是传奇瑞士合成器流行三人组Yello的创始成员之一，1983年离队后转向电子实验、电影配乐及概念性创作。两位音乐人的合作可追溯至更早的作品，Perón曾为Melting Rust Opera的EP混音并为其2024年专辑做母带处理。作为Side-Line的报道，文章以新闻信息为主，介绍了专辑的曲目、合作背景与发行细节，但缺乏对音乐本身深入的审美分析与声音描述。

items.body: New Zealand electronic rock band Robots In Love will release “Cease and Desist” on September 25, the second single from their upcoming album OVERRIDE. The Dunedin-based act is the creative partnership of vocalist and producer Elenor Rayner and drummer and producer Alex Burchell, joined again by guitarist Henry Flynn Wall of Rebirth To Ruin, who also featured on their previous single, “Convergence”. “Cease and Desist” is a melodic industrial track about extreme obsession. Rayner said she recently discovered the word “limerence” and began thinking about the inability to control obsession, which led to the line “limerence closes every door“, describing a state where no amount of reasoning can get through. Musically, the track scales back its verses before building into a chorus built on heavier riffs. The single also carries two remixes. Melbourne cyberpunk act Sirus contributes a version that moves through decades of electronic music, opening with an ’80s-style sound, passing through a ’90s R&B-inspired interlude and closing on darker, more futuristic production. Burchell also remixes the track under his own alias, Magnetique, in a more subversive take. “Cease and Desist” follows “Convergence”, released on June 8, 2026 as the lead single from OVERRIDE. “Convergence” has drawn over 41,000 YouTube views and 14,000 Spotify streams, and Robots In Love have paired “Cease and Desist” with an official video as well. About Robots In Love Robots In Love is the New Zealand electronic rock project of vocalist and producer Elenor Rayner and drummer and producer Alex Burchell, based in Dunedin (Ōtepoti). The current lineup came together in 2023, with Rayner and Burchell also working separately on other projects: Rayner has released material as Sobriquet and The Crystalline Effect, while Burchell drums with Angels Unchained and the Dunedin Symphony Orchestra and produces under the name Magnetique. The band mixes industrial rock, dark electro, drum and bass, trip hop, goth, metal and cyberpunk influences into a sound built on layered vocals, heavy guitars and electronic production. Side-Line has followed the band’s release history since 2022, when Robots In Love, then working as a New Zealand-based dark electro act, teamed up with Swedish producer JA/VI. They premiered the “Gossip In Your Head” video in September 2023, followed by an EP and remix video that November. In April 2024, the band premiered the “Unbreakable” video, and in January 2025 followed with the “Crush” video. Robots In Love released their debut album, “Activate!”, on May 23, 2025, reaching number 17 on the Aotearoa chart. “Convergence” arrived in June 2026 as the first single from OVERRIDE, with “Cease and Desist” now set to follow it on September 25.
items._cn_summary: 新西兰电子摇滚双人组即将发布新单曲《Cease and Desist》，作为专辑《OVERRIDE》的第二支单曲发行。这首旋律化的工业风格曲目围绕"极端执念"这一主题展开，主唱Elenor Rayner从"迷恋"这一概念出发，探讨理性无法穿透的执迷状态。编曲上，歌曲以克制的段落开场，逐步构建至以厚重吉他riff支撑的副歌部分。单曲附带两个混音版本：墨尔本赛博朋克乐队Sirus的版本横跨数十年电子音乐风格，从80年代音色穿越至90年代R&B间奏，最终落点于黑暗未来感的制作；Burchell则以个人名义Magnetique带来更具颠覆性的混音。乐队将工业摇滚、暗电子、鼓打贝斯、神游舞曲、哥特、金属和赛博朋克元素融合在一起，以人声层叠、厚重吉他与电子制作为骨架。

items.body: Dead Can Dance, the British-Australian neoclassical darkwave duo formed in Melbourne, released “Into the Labyrinth” on 13 September 1993 through 4AD. The album turns 33 this year. It was their sixth studio album, the first they recorded without any guest musicians, and the first to get a major-label release in the United States, through 4AD’s distribution deal with Warner Bros. Records. It went on to sell more than 500,000 copies worldwide and made the duo 4AD’s highest-selling act. Recording ‘Into the Labyrinth’ at Quivvy Church Lisa Gerrard and Brendan Perry had separated domestically in 1989. Perry was living in County Cavan, Ireland, Gerrard in Australia, and the two wrote their material apart. Gerrard then travelled to Perry’s studio, a converted church at Quivvy, where they merged the songs and recorded the album across three months. Perry engineered and produced it there. Every instrument on the record is played by the two of them, including bongos, sitar and tabla. Gerrard sings in English on tracks 2 to 4, 8 and 11, and uses her wordless vocal technique on tracks 1, 5 to 7, 9 and 10. Tracks 3 and 10 were performed a cappella. Two of the eleven tracks are not the duo’s own writing. “The Wind That Shakes the Barley” is a late 18th-century Irish ballad with words and music by Robert Dwyer Joyce, arranged by the band. Gerrard explained in the album’s press kit why she wanted to record it: “it was meant to be a rallying song, but it has such an intense sadness that it becomes an anti-war song”. The closing “How Fortunate the Man With None” sets four stanzas of Bertolt Brecht’s 1928 poem “Die Ballade von den Prominenten”, in John Willett’s English translation, to music Perry wrote for a Temenos Academy production of the play. It was only the second time the Brecht estate had granted such permission, the first being in 1963. Perry described “The Ubiquitous Mr Lovegrove”, the album’s single, as his alter ego, “the abstract relationship of myself and woman”. The title comes from a 1965 episode of the TV series “Danger Man”. 4AD assembled a video for “Yulunga (Spirit Dance)” using footage from the film “Baraka”. The eleven tracks run “Yulunga (Spirit Dance)”, “The Ubiquitous Mr Lovegrove”, “The Wind That Shakes the Barley”, “The Carnival Is Over”, “Ariadne”, “Saldek”, “Towards the Within”, “Tell Me About the Forest (You Once Called Home)”, “The Spider’s Stratagem”, “Emmeleia” and “How Fortunate the Man With None”. In the UK the CD arrived alongside a limited double vinyl LP that added “Bird” and “Spirit”, the two bonus tracks from the 1991 compilation “A Passage in Time”. Touhami Ennadre supplied the cover photograph, “Hands of the World”; Chris Bigg designed the sleeve with Perry, and Ken Kavanagh shot the booklet images. The US release followed on 14 September 1993. About Dead Can Dance Dead Can Dance formed in Melbourne in August 1981 as a trio, with Brendan Perry on vocals and guitar, Paul Erikson on bass and Simon Monroe on drums. Lisa Gerrard, previously of Microfilm, joined on vocals and percussion. Perry and Gerrard had met through Melbourne’s Little Band scene. Their first official recording, a home version of “Fatal Impact”, appeared on the December 1981 issue of the cassette magazine Fast Forward. After a farewell show at St Kilda’s Crystal Ballroom in May 1982 the pair moved to London and signed to 4AD, with Erikson and Peter Ulrich completing the first UK line-up. The self-titled debut arrived in February 1984, its sleeve built around a New Guinea ritual mask, and sat close to the ethereal wave of labelmates Cocteau Twins. The EP “Garden of the Arcane Delights” followed in August. From “Spleen and Ideal” (November 1985), co-produced with John A. Rivers and scored for cello, trombone and timpani, the duo turned towards the medieval and Renaissance material that became their signature; the album reached number 2 on the UK indie chart. Dead Can Dance’s ‘Within the Realm of a Dying Sun’ came in 1987, “The Serpent’s Egg” in 1988 and “Aion” in 1990, before “Into the Labyrinth” brought the ethnic instrumentation to the front of the arrangements. A world tour in 1994 produced the live album and film “Toward the Within”, recorded in California. Gerrard issued her solo debut “The Mirror Pool” in 1995, then reunited with Perry for “Spiritchaser” in 1996, which topped Billboard’s Top World Music Albums chart. Sessions for a follow-up broke down in 1998 and the duo separated, with one track from those tapes, “The Lotus Eaters”, surfacing on the box set “Dead Can Dance (1981-1998)” and on “Wake” in 2003. Gerrard recorded “Duality” with Pieter Bourke; Perry released “Eye of the Hunter” in 1999. They reunited for a 2005 European and North American tour, documented across a series of limited live releases, then returned to the studio for Dead Can Dance’s ‘Anastasis’ on 13 August 2012. Perry sold the Quivvy Church studio in 2015. “Dionysus”, mastered at Abbey Road, followed on 2 November 2018, and the duo toured Europe in 2022. In 2025 Perry said he was working on a sequel called “Apollo”, with himself as the only musician. New material has since appeared on Bandcamp through the band’s own Holy Tongue Records: “Our Day Will Come” on 20 March 2026, “Death Cults” in April, and Dead Can Dance release ‘The Cicadas’ single via Bandcamp in July. Thirty-three years on, “Into the Labyrinth” remains the record that took the duo from the 4AD roster to the Billboard 200.
items._cn_summary: Dead Can Dance的第六张录音室专辑于1993年发行，由澳大利亚-爱尔兰二人组Brendan Perry与Lisa Gerrard在没有客座乐手的情况下完成。专辑录制于爱尔兰Cavan郡一座由教堂改造的录音室，耗时三个月。所有乐器由二人亲自演奏，包括邦戈鼓、西塔琴和塔布拉鼓。Gerrard在部分曲目中采用无歌词人声演唱技巧，另有两首无伴奏纯人声作品。专辑收录了改编自18世纪爱尔兰民谣的曲目，以及取材自Bertolt Brecht诗篇的配乐作品，后者获得布莱希特遗产委员会罕见的授权。歌词写作跨越两大洲完成，乐曲编排融合古典、欧洲民谣与中东及南亚音乐元素，呈现跨文化的声学探索。

items.body: Krimea is an Italian duo formed in 2021 by Alice Taylor and Nick SoLow. Over the past few months, they have released three singles, all of which are included on this debut album. “Are You Human?” features 12 tracks largely inspired by relationships. From the very first notes, you can recognize the Electro-Pop influence that drives the duo. What also stands out immediately is the quality of the production and mixing. Krimea has clearly invested considerable time and expertise in creating a polished, high-quality record. The songs themselves are powerful Electro-Pop, yet they also possess a cold, atmospheric quality, incorporating vintage sounds and effects such as sweeps. Two songs are featuring guitar play. Certain sounds occasionally remind me of Kraftwerk, although this influence has clearly been transformed into a style and vibe that is uniquely their own. The vocal production is excellent, featuring a charismatic male voice alongside a warmer, ethereal female voice. She often provides backing vocals but occasionally steps forward for genuine duets. This is an interesting debut featuring several strong tracks. I look forward to hearing more from this duo, which, in my opinion, is clearly ready for a record deal. (Rating:7½). Listen to “Die-Monds”: “Die – monds” by Krimea About Krimea Krimea is an electro-pop duo from Venice, Italy, formed in 2021 by Alice Taylor and Nick SoLow. “Are You Human?”, released 10 April 2026, is the duo’s debut album, gathering twelve tracks written by Krimea and produced and mastered by William Benedetti. Guitar on “This Pleasure” and “Vivre le sombre” was played by Cosimo Mitrugno, with artwork photography by Matteo Bosi, per the band’s own Bandcamp credits. The album follows three singles issued ahead of release: “This Pleasure,” “Die-Monds” and “Over and Over,” all included on the final tracklist alongside nine additional songs. Bandcamp’s own album notes describe “Die-Monds” as built around the wordplay of “die” and “monds” (diamonds), with Alice Taylor crediting a vintage Poly800 II synthesizer for the track’s melodic range. No prior Side-Line coverage of Krimea has been found.
items._cn_summary: 意大利双人组合Krimea的首张专辑收录十二首曲目，主题围绕人际关系展开。整体风格以电子流行为核心，制作与混音质量受到肯定，编曲中融入了复古合成器音色、扫频效果以及偶尔的吉他演奏，营造出冷峻而富有氛围感的听感。评论提及Kraftwerk的影响痕迹，但二人已将其转化为自身的独特风格表达。人声编排方面，男性主唱具备个人魅力，女性成员则以温暖空灵的声线担任和声或参与对唱。评论认为这是一张具备若干出色曲目的有趣首作，并期待组合未来获得唱片合约。整体定位偏向精致的合成器流行制作，在创新性与实验性方面着墨有限，更注重成品打磨与类型内的扎实呈现。

items.body: With a picturesque, pastoral centre, Southern Points reclines towards the warmth of the sunshine. Patient and flexible, the latest release from Greg Baird’s Moss Covered Technology project shelters in the safety – and the surrounding beauty – of the countryside: open fields and cresting hills, kissing gates tucked away behind stone walls and leaves blowing in a breeze of scented blossom. Southern Points (Hibernate) hits all the right notes… Sparse, spacious, and introverted, the ambient soundscapes reflect a period of deep introspection for Baird. Choosing to focus on family life and life at home, there’s something very comforting about the tones here: they’re gentle and approachable, with warm smiles lighting up familiar faces. With the use of a Prophet 12, varying effects pedals, and processed field recordings, the soundscapes stretch out and the flowering melodies melt in the light of a Spring sun. The lightest wind wisps by, and heavier, supporting drones hint at a strengthening of the sunlight as an early morning haze turns to the strong musculature of midday. Scenery is crucial to the record, and its beauty was experienced first-hand. Baird is an eye-witness to the wonder of the day, and he translates this slice of peace into the language of music. It all came from a day out, the scenery and nature around him inspiring the creation of the album. Baird’s photos acted as additional inspiration during the writing and creating process. The organic ambient hues help to turn the original image into music…but it goes at a sedate pace, with everything coming to fruition at just the right time, waiting for the right season. The album is warm – but not boiling. Listeners will still need a gilet and a light outer layer, but it’s indicative of Spring’s welcoming touch. Light electronics scrape against the side of a wooden fence. New shoots rise up from the soil; birds begin to chirp; the evenings are lighter for longer. Bursts of lavender colour the fields. The countryside beckons. www.hibernate.bandcamp.com
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以乡村风景为创作灵感，作者将一日户外的所见所感转化为音乐语言。核心制作围绕Prophet 12合成器、多种效果器以及经处理的田野录音展开，营造出稀疏开阔、缓慢内省的声音景观。整体温度偏暖但不燥热，旋律如春日花蕾般渐进绽放，底层的持续音和氛围层次缓慢支撑起结构的纵深感。作者本人同时提供了摄影作品作为创作参照，使得音乐与视觉之间形成互文。田野录音与电子合成的结合是专辑的核心手法，但整体走向偏向温和的氛围表达，缺乏强烈的实验突破或声音设计上的冒险。

items.body:
The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._genre: New Orleans R&B / funk / voodoo jazz / Mardi Gras revue
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑记录了Dr. John于1999年在德国莱茵河畔Loreley露天剧场的演出实况，由WDR的Rockpalast系列录制发行。演出以新奥尔良经典'Iko Iko'开场，融入Mardi Gras游行式的半唱半诵社区互动，随后展开涵盖funk、voodoo神秘主义与NOLA传统的曲目编排。乐队编制精简，吉他、贝斯与鼓构成紧凑四重奏，支撑钢琴主导的现场表演。除经典新奥尔良标准曲外，演出还收录了Dr. John本人创作的'Sweet Home New Orleans''Right Place Wrong Time'，并向Duke Ellington与Earl King致敬。整场表演展现了音乐跨越语言与文化障碍的感染力，既是档案级收藏，也是入门了解Dr. John现场艺术的窗口。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / documentary / soundscape
items._cn_summary: 这是一张并非传统意义上音乐作品的田野录音专辑，由录音师伊恩·布伦南在芝加哥南区街头录制。二十五位枪支暴力幸存者参与了录音，他们的年龄从十七岁到六十七岁不等，内容包括口述经历和自由说唱。录制地点位于一位九十四岁祖母家门前，正值特朗普下令向该市部署国民警卫队之日。专辑未添加任何音乐，仅保留了环境声音。参与者中有失去两个儿子的老人，也有刚从追悼会归来的女性。收益将捐赠给Cure Violence Global组织。这张作品更像是社会现实的声音文献，而非音乐创作，展现了被遗忘社区中暴力影响的广泛性。

items._cn_summary: 这是一则关于Big Ears音乐节2027年阵容的新闻公告，宣布该节将于4月1日至4日在田纳西州诺克斯维尔市中心回归，呈现超过250场演出、电影、讲座和装置艺术，分布于20多个场地。2027年阵容的重点之一是庆祝Bang on a Can乐团的40周年，Bang on a Can All-Stars将演奏David Lang的谜题奏鸣曲、Julia Wolfe的Steel Symphonies等作品。该音乐节历来以策划当代古典、实验音乐、即兴演奏和跨领域艺术项目著称，演出内容涵盖现代作曲、前卫爵士、电子音乐和声音装置等多个领域。本次阵容延续了这一策展方向，聚焦于新音乐领域的核心艺术家与作品。原文章为简短的新闻摘要，缺乏详细的音乐评论与分析，信息量有限。

items.body: Review by arcane-beautiful — Overall, I don't think these guys have a bad album, and while this is my least favourite of them, there are a lot of great moments and tracks on this one. Overall there is a different feel to this album, as if the band are moving away from their caustic and more mathcore roots, and transitioning into a more progressive metal sound. Lyrically the album feels very different too, being less conceptual and having more personal moments. But the musicianship is fantastic, it's just a slight variation in vibes and a sound from the band I prefer dampened slightly. The track I'd recommend is C'est La Vie.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑被评价为乐队从早期数学核风格向前卫金属过渡的作品，放弃了部分原有的尖锐感和数学核根源，转向更渐进化的金属表达。歌词方面不再以概念性叙事为主，转向更私人的情感表达。乐评人认为整体演奏水准依然出色，但这种风格转向使其成为该乐队作品中个人偏好最低的一张。专辑中推荐了《C'est La Vie》作为亮点曲目。整体定位介于技术金属与前卫金属之间，但在实验性和创新性上偏向传统金属框架的渐进演化，未能深度触及更前卫或实验音乐领域。

items.body: Review by alainPP — Last Knight is a musical project established in 1997 by Jose Medina, featuring musicians such as Marc Atkinson (Riversea, Moon Halo), Mariano Gardella, Deibys Artigas, Rafael Pacha (guitars, also with The Samurai of Prog), and Troy Donockley (Nightwish)."The Grand Overture" is a cinematic musical narrative blending classical, folk, and medieval elements?a monumental opening piece with interwoven textures. "In the Middle Ages" navigates between Alan Parsons and the Beatles, featuring a captivating melody sung theatrically by Mariano, accompanied by Sacha's poignant, arpeggiated guitar work that evokes a harsh era. "The Kingdom of Asturias" is an acoustic instrumental reflecting rugged times, with a recorder ushering the listener into a Christian kingdom on the defensive. "A War of Eight Centuries" is an anthemic, chilling interlude with Marc narrating eight centuries of conflict. "Cordoba" features Sacha's arpeggios?recalling a time when beauty and art contended with war?and vibrant Andalusian guitar. On "War," Deibys sings a tune reminiscent of Rainbow, while vintage keyboards evoke Ayreon; Nelson delivers an 80s-style guitar solo that captures the chaos. "Chivalry Tales" is an interlude driven by percussive bass and Hammond organ, with piano flourishes that skip along like knights in battle. "A Green Field of Memories" is a somber ballad, a medieval-style piece humming with acoustic notes."The Kingdom of Leon" serves as a symphonic instrumental sequel?a sweeping epic in the vein of The Samurai of Prog and Alan Parsons. It features spellbinding keyboards, Troy's bagpipes, violins, and various flutes that conjure up the world of *Lord of the Rings*, elves, and imagined medieval tales. The organ engages in a playful duel with the guitar, while the drums drive the entertaining progressive soundscape; a notable mid-song break sees the bass aggressively challenge the organ in a moment that feels simultaneously Floyd-esque, Western, and cinematic. Note the finale, where the Andalusian influence revisits the "Spaghetti Western" atmosphere to create something truly divine. "Flames Would Rise"?referencing the flames meant for heretics?features a scorching vocal performance that sends shivers down the spine. "Across the Mountains" serves as an interlude that traverses the Pyrenees on the wings of a flute melody. "The Kingdom of Galicia" offers a second epic tableau, blending folk, jazz, and world music vibes; it features a hushed, atmospheric sound reminiscent of Unitopia, balanced by Oldfield-esque Celtic moods and hurdy-gurdy and mandolin played by Sacha. There is room for furious heavy guitar work and a cinematic melting pot narrated by Mariano, acting as the resident bard. Mellotron adds a sentimental medieval touch, leading into a distinctive outro. "Pamplona" is a baroque harpsichord interlude that captures an elegiac splendor. "The Backyard" is a pastoral sketch for flute and acoustic guitar, paving the way for a cinematic finale. Finally, "Hymn for Asturias" features Deibys singing of the cycle's end?a prayerful lament that nonetheless exudes hope, underscored by Troy's flute.Last Knight?a tale of medieval glory; rest assured, this first saga will captivate you, marking the beginning of a trilogy. It is a concept of cathedral-like proportions, blending symphonic prog with exhilarating cinematic folk. A perfect example of the genre.
items._genre: crossover prog / symphonic prog / neoclassical folk
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以中世纪西班牙收复失地运动为叙事线索，将古典、民间音乐与交响前卫摇滚融合，呈现出宏大的电影化音景。作品包含多首器乐间奏与人声叙事段落，融合了阿尔罕布拉吉他、风笛、键盘和管弦乐元素，呈现出中世纪色彩与《指环王》式的奇幻氛围。虽然专辑尝试融合多种文化元素，但整体仍属于传统前卫摇滚范畴内的跨界作品，叙事驱动明显而实验性有限。邀请了Riversea、The Samurai of Prog、Nightwish等乐队乐手参与，呈现成熟但偏保守的制作风格。对偏好实验与前卫即兴的听众而言，过于结构化和旋律化；不过其世界音乐元素与西班牙地方特色的融入仍值得关注。

いずみシンフォニエッタ大阪音楽監督・藤倉大が敬愛しているポーランドの作曲家ジグムント・クラウゼを中心に、日本初演となる作品と、名誉音楽監督の西村朗による作品で構成されたプログラム。演奏は、日本の現代音楽シーンで活躍している北村朋幹（ピアノ）と中川日出鷹（ファゴット）、そしていずみシンフォニエッタ大阪（指揮は松井慶太）。前日には「クラウゼを知ろう！」と題した藤倉大と北村朋幹によるトークイベントも開催され、日本ではあまり知られていない巨匠を知ることができる、よい機会となるだろう。 詳細はこちら   10/4 チームアップ！オペラ《アマールと夜の訪問者》 会場：たましんRISURUホール 大ホール 大規模改修による休館中の東京文化会館が、たましんRISURUホール（立川市市民会館）で、メノッティ作曲《アマールと夜の訪問者》を、柴田真郁の指揮、岩田達宗の演出で上演する。 東京音楽コンクール入賞者を中心とするキャストに加え、武蔵野音楽大学の学生・高校生・児童合唱・ワークショップ参加者が、羊飼いたちや村人として出演。プロの音楽家と若い世代がともにつくり上げるオペラに注目したい。 詳細はこちら   10/4 伝統芸能のススメ［雅楽］今昔雅楽集 四、秋庭歌一具～武満徹没後30年記念企画～ 会場：水戸芸術館コンサートホールATM 武満徹没後30年に水戸芸術館が贈る企画第2弾は、武満最長の作品にして現代雅楽の傑作『秋庭歌一具』をメインに、武満が初めて雅楽と出会った古典雅楽作品と、笙とオーボエの二重奏曲『ディスタンス』という充実のプログラム。演奏は伶楽舎、笙：宮田まゆみ、オーボエ：荒木奏美。「音がたちのぼる」と武満が表現した雅楽の古くて新しい音響に身を委ねたい。 詳細はこちら       10/5 ロイヤル・バンコク交響楽団東京公演 会場：すみだトリフォニーホール ＜アジアオーケストラウィーク2026＞は10年ぶりの来日となるタイを代表するロイヤル・バンコク交響楽団（RBSO）の登場。1982年に創設され活発な活動を展開、タイを代表する文化大使として国内外を駆け巡っている。アルメニアが生んだ若き巨匠セルゲイ・スムバティアン指揮、第15回チャイコフスキー国際コンクール覇者ドミトリー・マスレエフをピアノに迎え、 ナロングリット・ダーマブトラ：シャムの音景、ラフマニノフ：ピアノ協奏曲 第2番、ドヴォルザーク：交響曲 第8番 というラインアップ。なお、オーケストラ・アンサンブル金沢との特別合同演奏会が輪島（輪島市立輪島中学校）で開催される。他に出演・曲目の異なる金沢公演あり。 詳細はこちら 10/6 青木尚佳（ヴァイオリン）＆ ジャノ・リスボア（ヴィオラ）＆ ウェン＝シン・ヤン（チェロ） 会場：浜離宮朝日ホール 2021年ミュンヘン・フィルハーモニー管弦楽団初の女性コンサートマスターに就任の青木尚佳、同団第1首席ヴィオラ奏者ジャノ・リスボア、ミュンヘン音大で教鞭をとるウェン＝シン・ヤン（シュタルケル、ゲリンガスに師事）と、気心知れたメンバーでの室内楽の楽しみ。ベートーヴェン：弦楽三重奏曲ニ長調、ジョルジュ・クルターグ：《Signs, Games and Messages》より抜粋、J.S.バッハ（シトコヴェツキー編）：ゴルトベルク変奏曲（弦楽三重奏版）。洗練の一夜を楽しめよう。 詳細はこちら   10/13 アレクサンダー・ガジェヴ「カレイドスコープ第2夜 リサイタル ～5台のピアノ弾き比べ」 会場：東京オペラシティ コンサートホール 第18回ショパン国際ピアノコンクールで第2位及びソナタ最優秀演奏賞を受賞で注目されたガジェヴ。プレイエルによるショパン、ベーゼンドルファーによるベートーヴェン、カワイやスタインウェイでの諸作品、ファツィオリでは武満や即興という５台ピアノでのリサイタル。なんという贅沢。刺激的だ。ピアノ好きには垂涎の企画。第１夜の室内楽も聴き逃せない（9/29）。 詳細はこちら     10/16 ラ・フォンテヴェルデ第40回定期演奏会 マドリガル劇場～笑いあり、涙ありのイタリアン・マドリガルの名作を！！ 会場：Hakuju Hall 16～17世紀のマドリガーレを中心に活動してきたラ・フォンテヴェルデは、2023年に大好評を博した音楽風刺劇《オスペダーレ》の日本初演以降、マドリガル・コメディにも力を入れている。今回はマドリガル・コメディの大家であるバンキエリの代表作を中心にしたプログラム。歌唱力はもちろん、コメディ・センス抜群の彼らが繰り広げる17世紀初頭の喜劇を楽しんでみませんか？ 詳細はこちら     10/18 矢代秋雄 没後五十年記念コンサート 会場：浜離宮朝日ホール 日本現代音楽シーンにおける、保守派と言うにはあまりにもそのエクリチュールが超絶的な作曲家、矢代秋雄の若すぎる没後50年を記念したコンサート。ピアノに青柳いづみこ・田所光之マルセル、フルートに多久和怜子・占部智美。矢代が遺した数少ない室内楽の傑作に耳を傾けよう。 詳細はこちら       10/21 ベルカント王国〜オペラの美声でロックを歌っちゃいます!!! 会場：代官山 晴れたら空に豆まいて オペラの美声でロックを歌う！ このコンセプトを見たときに、最初に思い出したのがクラウス・ノミ。1980年代のはじめ、ニューウェーブやアリアをカウンター・テナーで歌う強烈な姿は、今なお強い印象を残している。しかし彼の早すぎる死によって、歌声を通して多様な音楽をまとめあげる試みは頓挫したといってもいい。一方の器楽の世界では、民族音楽からアニメ音楽まで、多種多様な音楽ジャンルを飲み込んで、新たな世界を切り開いている。それでは声楽の世界では？ 鬼が出るか蛇が出るか。立川直樹氏とプロデューサーの湯山玲子氏との対談とともに、どのような世界を切り開くのか、楽しみにしたい。 詳細はこちら 10/26、27、29、30、31、11/1 国際モーツァルテウム財団コンサート モーツァルト「悠久の旋律」 会場：東京／第一生命ホールほか 国際モーツァルテウム財団と第一生命との友好により開催の特別記念イベント「国際モーツァルテウム財団コンサート モーツァルト『悠久の旋律』」が10月下旬から東京・札幌・大阪・名古屋・福岡で開催される。出演はアクツィオ・ピアノ・トリオに加え、永峰高志（ヴァイオリン）、松実健太（ヴィオラ）の2人が参加。オール・モーツァルト・プログラムで「ピアノ三重奏曲第2番」「ピアノ四重奏曲第1番」のほか、2024年9月にドイツのライプツィヒ市立図書館で筆写譜が再発見されたセレナード「ガンツ・クライネ・ナハトムジーク」。使用楽器は、モーツァルト自身が演奏したと伝えられる「コスタ・ヴァイオリン」。まさに悠久の旋律を堪能あれ。入場無料・要事前申込（東京公演受付終了） items.body: Label: Shift Paradigm Records, 2026 Personnel - Zeju Zheng: guitar; Arnie Sainz: piano; Drew Gress: bass; Chidiebere Emmanuel: drums. Emerging guitarist Zeju Zheng is based in New York, the city he relocated to in order to pursue a Master's Degree in Jazz Performance at New York University. Zheng, who studied under Peter Bernstein and Adam Rogers, releases his debut album, A Mind in Motion , which features six original compositions exploring themes of transition, memory, hope, and discovery. The pieces, written and recorded during Zheng's early years in New York, are performed by a quartet featuring pianist Arnie Sainz, seasoned bassist Drew Gress, and Nigerian-born drummer Chidiebere Emmanuel. " 53 " is pure post-bop sophistication in 5/4, spreading fragments of Miles and Shorter's ESP years. Invigorating tonal and rhythmic shifts, a straightforward swinging drive, and expressively patterned and articulated solos from Zheng and Sainz make this an exciting opener. “ Simple ", whose 6/8 feel creates an exciting spark, emerged from Zheng's studies with eclectic guitarist Brad Shepik. His influence transpires in the guitarist's busy yet precise solo. Before that, Sainz excels in phrasing and mood, likely spurred by Gress's decisive bass figure at the bottom. Guitar and piano unisons revisit the theme, providing a tidy resolution. Zheng showcases a balladic side on tunes like " Drain ", whose sense of calmness inspires a notable solo from Gress, and " At The Corner ", where the band plunges into a meditative melodic languor offered with a rich, rounded quality. The mellow tone speaks directly to the album's themes, and in both pieces, Gress and Emmanuel fulfill their foundational roles with trust. Far from casting us in a dimmer light are the two final tracks: the nicely tempered " Little Song ", and the harmonically rich " Waiting For You To Be Home ", which frees the emotions while finding comfort in hope and light. Rooted in tradition yet incorporating charismatic contemporary elements, the pieces in A Mind in Motion are rendered with lithe and spry interplay. Zheng is confirmed as a name to watch in the future. Favorite Tracks: 01 - “53" ► 03 - Simple ► 06 - Waiting For You To Be Home
items._cn_summary: 吉他手郑泽矩在纽约大学攻读爵士表演硕士期间录制的首张专辑，收录六首原创作品，主题围绕变迁、记忆与希望展开。乐队编制为吉他、钢琴、贝斯与鼓的经典四重奏，乐评指出其风格扎根于后波普传统，开篇曲"53"采用5/4拍，融入了Miles Davis和Wayne Shorter在ESP厂牌时期的碎片感。"Simple"受Brad Shepik影响，6/8拍律动中展现忙碌而精确的吉他独奏。"Drain"与"At The Corner"呈现抒情一面，乐队进入冥想式的旋律氛围，贝斯与鼓奠定沉稳基础。终曲"Waiting For You To Be Home"在和声上较为丰富，情绪上趋向温暖与希望。整体演奏流畅，互动灵活，但乐评对其创新性着墨不多，更像是对传统的延续与稳健演绎。

items.body:
Japanese progressive rock band Cö shu Nie are heading to Singapore for the first time.

The band will make their Singapore debut at the Cö shu Nie – Live in Singapore show on 2 December at the Esplanade Annexe Studio. Presented by LAMC Presents, the concert is part of the band's first world tour, SATURATED in monochrome.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by L.A.M.C. (@lamcpresents)

Fronted by Miku Nakamura, Cö shu Nie are known for a genre-fluid sound that brings together progressive rock, electronic textures, intricate melodies, and what the band describes as "delicate chaos".

The Japanese outfit made their major debut in 2018 with 'asphyxia', which served as the opening theme for Tokyo Ghoul:re. Their music has since appeared across anime titles including The Promised Neverland, Psycho-Pass 3, Jujutsu Kaisen, Code Geass, and Black Butler.

In 2025, Nakamura and the band's longtime business partner Kaz Skellington founded independent record label RVRNC. Cö shu Nie released their first independent album, SATURATED (in monochrome), in 2026 before embarking on their first world tour.

items.body: Review by Alxrm — The beginning of the real Rush - no offense to John Rutsey and the debut album which I really like- but Geddy and Alex ever since were aspiring for a deeper sound and a more progressive direction which didn't appeal to John. This is made plain even from the intro of the opener of the album which actually was the jamming they did together when Neil was auditioning for the band. Even though the music remains essentially rock and most song durations are around the three-minute mark, the first twists and turns make the presence felt. More than that, acoustic (Fly by Night, In the End) and classical (Rivendell) guitars are tastefully used to widen their palette of sound. However, the key-track on the album is the suite By-Tor & The Snow Dog because its complex structure would become their compass for the future where they would go off their pure rock roots entirely.Compared to the debut, the listener can easily perceive the growth the band underwent within such a short amount of time. The unstrained enthousiasm is replaced by deeper and at times more complex compositions showing clearly that the boys would not content themselves by repetition. Moreover, the new guy would become their standard lyricist and would go down in history as one of the best of all time. We should thank our luck that their paths were crossed.

items._cn_summary: 这是Rush乐队1975年发行的第二张专辑，标志着Neil Peart加入后乐队从硬摇滚向更深层次、前卫方向的转折。评论指出，开场曲的intro源于Neil试音时的即兴jam，展现了新阵容的化学反应。专辑在多数歌曲仍保持三分钟左右摇滚时长的同时，开始引入原声吉他段落（如Fly by Night、In the End）和古典吉他短曲（Rivendell），拓宽了音色谱系。核心曲目By-Tor & The Snow Dog以复杂结构预示了乐队日后彻底脱离纯摇滚根脉的走向。与首张专辑相比，乐评认为乐队的成长体现在编曲深度与复杂度的提升，以及Neil作为词作者为乐队带来的长远影响。整体而言，这是一支主流摇滚乐队在前卫方向上的初步探索。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — If you have followed my reviews spanning the prog folk diaspora, you'll know there is nothing I welcome less than another version of "Scarborough Fair", with which particularly Nordic groups seem disproportionately enamored. It therefore follows that I cannot recommend an album in which arguably the best track is in this single-song sub genre. Sadly this is the case for the extinct-on-arrival dinosaur known now as the "Kaarmesormus". It might garner 3 stars from a new group just based on the continued mellotron blasts but not from esteemed veterans like KOSMOS, and, while each number could be a supporting cast on a better album, this isn't that. From the soporific first half to the plodding and equally exhausted faux metal second half with its SSRI-free spoken interludes, this is all a big downer, and I do normally appreciate the authentically morose. If I had to pick a couple they would be the opener and "Kielletyn hedelm�n tarha", but both are essentially submerged in their surroundings. Like a therapist once said to a friend who cried incessantly through the first few sessions, "you need a good drug". Start anywhere else and let this one slither off to the side until you are emotionally ready. 2.5 stars rounded down.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由老牌北欧前卫民谣团体KOSMOS发行，试图在传统民谣素材基础上拓展表现空间，包括对经典曲目《Scarborough Fair》的重新诠释。乐评指出，专辑前段旋律缓慢、缺乏起伏，后半部分加入伪金属段落与口语化间奏，试图制造情绪对比，但整体显得疲软且重复，未能形成有效张力。mellotron铺底虽提供一定氛围厚度，却无法掩盖结构上的松散与缺乏新意。评论者明确建议跳过此作，先从其他专辑入手。

items.body: Review by A Crimson Mellotron — This might be the first time I have not been taken aback by a new Mastodon album, simply because theexpectations have been exceedingly high this time around. A reflection upon the dramatic passing offounding member Brent Hinds, following his departure from the band earlier, 'Marrow Deep' is arecord exploring grief through a variety of dense and ominous sounds. This is not necessarily areturn to the extreme and primal energy that had shaped the Atlanta-based band's early records, butit comes close to being their most straightforward metal album in years. Having added touringguitarist Nick Johnston and keyboardist Jo�o Nogueira to the lineup, this five-piece version ofMastodon is intriguing, but it lacks the untamed songwriting of Brent Hinds and his overtlypsychedelic undercurrents. For this reason, 'Marrow Deep' is somewhat less adventurous thanpreceding releases from the band, even if it preserves the sludge-informed prog metal framework thatlisteners have become accustomed to. It just feels solid all throughout but without significantpeaks.Production-wise, this album is strong but not groundbreaking, with the heavy guitars occupying mostof the mix. I do, however, vastly enjoy the prominent contributions of the band's full-time keyboardplayer, whose playing provides a beautiful atmospheric backdrop to the otherwise ravaging guitars ofBill Kelliher and Nick Johnston. Interestingly enough, there is a greater highlight on melodictextures and sombre passages on 'Marrow Deep', that had only been superficially explored on 'Hushedand Grim'. Nevertheless, this new Mastodon record feels meandering without really having any weakmoments. Highlight tracks like the fast-paced 'Snakes for Dinner', the ritualistic sludgy number'They're Coming for You', and the tasteful but melancholic song 'The Vanishing', featuring GeezerButler and reminiscent of the great 'Planet Caravan', are perhaps the only moments worth lookingforward to upon repeated listens, while monotonous heavy numbers like 'Poisonous Weapons' and 'Inthe Ruins' lack the novel and mind-bending edge that used to make each new Mastodon something toanticipate.Longtime fans of the band will discover heaps of excellent, wild and turbulent riffs here, while theenjoyers of the band's progressive leanings shall be pleased with the haunting keyboards appearingon 'Marrow Deep'. Consistent and straightforward, this record hardly reinvents the Mastodon sound,which is very likely why it doesn't fully click with me.
items._genre: progressive metal / sludge metal / tech metal
items._cn_summary: Mastodon 2026年专辑《Marrow Deep》以哀悼已故创始成员 Brent Hinds 为核心主题，在密集阴郁的声响中探讨悲伤情绪。乐队加入巡演吉他手 Nick Johnston 与全职键盘手 João Nogueira，以五人阵容呈现。整体保持 sludge 影响的渐进金属框架，键盘的突出表现为厚重吉他提供了氛围层次。评论指出专辑虽扎实稳定但缺乏显著高峰，旋律质感与阴郁段落比前作更为突出。亮点集中在快速节奏的《Snakes for Dinner》、仪式化的《They're Coming for You》以及与 Geezer Butler 合作、风格致敬《Planet Caravan》的《The Vanishing》。评论者认为作品直白连续却未能真正重塑乐队声音，缺乏昔日每张专辑都具备的新颖与迷幻特质。

items.body: 2026.09.14 海外クラシックNEWS～from イギリス 海外のクラシック界のニュースやコンサート、オペラ公演の様子を、現地在住の筆者がいちはやくお届け。今回は英国の8月の音楽シーンから、ロンドンで行われたBBCプロムスのもようをレポートします。 原田 真帆 Maho Harada ヴァイオリニスト・博士（音楽） 多様性のあるレパートリーの構築を目指して、日本と英国を拠点に活動。東京藝術大学音楽学部附属音楽高等学校を経て同大学音楽学部器楽科卒業、同声会賞を受賞。英国王立音楽院修... 詳しく見る 音楽の友 編集部 月刊誌 1941年12月創刊。音楽之友社の看板雑誌「音楽の友」を毎月刊行しています。“音楽の深層を知り、音楽家の本音を聞く”がモットー。今月号のコンテンツはこちらバックナンバ... 詳しく見る 先月に引き続き、BBCプロムスの話をしたい。ロイヤル・アルバート・ホールにて7月中旬に開幕、9月初旬まで毎日公演が行われており、筆者は8月もいくつかの公演に足を運んだ。 せっかくなので座席を替えて聴き比べ、結果として天井桟敷の部分にあたるギャラリーという立ち見席がよいのではないかという見解に行き着いた。全体が円形になった会場で、シューボックス型ホールのような反響板がないため音がすべて上に飛んでいくことを考慮すると、なるべく上で聴くほうがよい。最上階はさすがに舞台からの距離があって音の輪郭は少しぼやけるが、地上階よりもよほど各楽器のニュアンスが聞こえてくるので、プロムス名物のアリーナでのスタンディングよりおすすめできる。 本稿では3つの公演で聴いた管弦楽作品についてしたためる。それぞれの公演の協奏曲については、『音楽の友』2026年10月号でのレポートを参照されたい。 8月2日、BBC交響楽団とパーヴォ・ヤルヴィ（指揮）はダニ・ハワードの新作、「金管楽器のための協奏曲《SIGNAL》」とスクリャービン「交響曲第2番」を演奏した。ハワードは1993年香港生まれの作曲家。本作はBBCの委嘱作品で、この夜が世界初演だった。体裁としては管弦楽のための協奏曲と呼ばれるものに近い。フェスティヴァルの空気にふさわしく華々しい曲だった。 スクリャービンの交響曲は規模としてはラフマニノフやシベリウスのそれに似ている。複雑な管弦楽のなかにも抒情性があり、日本の聴衆にも好まれそうな気がした。ヤルヴィの棒は大編成でもしっかり統制を取って器用に進めていく。新曲では楽団と指揮が互いに少しよそいきの感もあったが、レオニダス・カヴァコス（vn）とのチャイコフスキーの協奏曲で温まったあとの交響曲は、充実のアンサンブルだった。 マンチェスターが拠点のハレ管弦楽団とその首席指揮者カーチュン・ウォンのコンビは、ラヴェル《鏡》から「第5曲〈鐘の谷〉」の管弦楽編曲（コリン・マシューズ版）と、ラフマニノフ「交響曲第2番」を熱演した（8月5日）。終始ハレ管とウォンの仲のよさが滲み出ていて、信頼の厚さを思わせる。ラヴェルは原曲を思い出させないほど管弦楽作品として聞こえてきたが、ピアノで聴くより散漫にも感じられた。 ナディア・ブーランジェ「ピアノと管弦楽のための幻想曲」（アレクサンドラ・ダリエスクp）を挟んだあとのラフマニノフは聴衆の熱狂が先立っていて、かの有名な第3楽章が始まる瞬間には会場に期待の空気が充満し、弾き手の気持ちがわかるものとしてはかえって緊張を覚えてしまう。しかしウォンは自信に満ちたタクトをおろし、楽団はそれに身を委ねるようにして無事に出航した。その夜の観客の多くはラフマニノフ目当てであっただろうが、ハレ管とウォンはその期待に充分応えきった。 首席指揮者を務めるハレ管をBBCプロムスで指揮したカーチュン・ウォン ©BBC / Chris Christodoulou ジェイムズ・ガフィガン指揮BBC響がウィントン・マルサリスの新作を英国初演 8月13日、ふたたびBBC交響楽団の演奏に触れた。この日はジェイムズ・ガフィガンを指揮に迎えて、ウィントン・マルサリス「オーケストラのための協奏曲」とサミュエル・バーバー「交響曲第1番《単一楽章の交響曲》」をガーシュウィン《ピアノ協奏曲 ヘ調》と組み合わせ、今年のプロムスのテーマであるアメリカ音楽を特集したプログラムを実施。マルサリス作品は共同委嘱新作で、世界初演はケルン放送交響楽団（2025年）、そしてロサンゼルス・フィルハーモニックによる米国初演（2025年）を経て、BBC響がこの日、英国初演を担った。作曲者がトランペット奏者なだけあって金管・打楽器が相当にぎやかな曲だが、よく整理された演奏で、膨大な音数をうまくまとめた。 バーバー作品は先日のスクリャービン作品ともまた違うパンチがあり、曲自体が持つエネルギーの強さが聴く側にも体力を求めてくる。しかも通称が示す通り楽章間を休みなしに続けるので、弾き手もかなりスタミナを要する曲だ。それでもオーケストラは聴き手を捉えて離さない集中力のある演奏で、根気強く聴かせた。
items._cn_summary: 本文为BBC普罗姆斯音乐节八月三场管弦乐公演的现场报告，涵盖BBC交响乐团与帕沃·雅尔维演奏的霍华德新作《SIGNAL》及斯克里亚宾第二交响曲、哈雷管弦乐团与黄祖麒合作的拉威尔与拉赫玛尼诺夫，以及加菲根指挥BBC交响乐团呈现的马尔萨利斯新作与巴伯、格什温等美国音乐专题。评论侧重演出场馆声学体验和现场氛围描述，对当代委约作品和经典曲目的演奏效果有所涉及，但整体聚焦于主流古典曲目与大型交响乐团编制，以传统音乐会综述为主，未涉及实验性、先锋性或跨领域融合元素，对偏好前沿与即兴类音乐的听众而言信息量有限。

items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. items.excerpt:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur. Weird and wonderful, it sounds
items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是Dominique Cravic与Les Primitifs du futur的第五张作品，由地下漫画家Robert Crumb绘制封面。乐评将他们的声音形容为从阁楼中翻出大量78转唱片后用各类老旧乐器重新演绎的结果，乐器涵盖手风琴、萨克斯、班卓琴、尤克里里、特雷门琴、夏威夷吉他甚至音乐锯。Cravic以类似Maurice Chevalier的念白式演唱贯穿27首短曲，融合法国手风琴舞厅音乐、拉格泰姆、 Jug乐队、法国香颂与斯基夫尔等多种老派风格。其中《Ukulele Lady》是1925年老歌的幽默翻唱，《N'oublie pas Gréco》则是对2020年去世的法国抵抗运动歌手Juliette Gréco的致敬。乐评将其类比为同样难以归类的Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks，强调老乐手以严肃态度和热情复活被遗忘的曲风。

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以1819年曼彻斯特圣彼得广场屠杀事件为题材，将历史叙事融入原创民谣歌曲中。Sean Cooney联合小提琴手Eliza Carthy、吉他手Sam Carter等音乐人，以小编制却响亮的方式演绎，歌词聚焦普通人的故事与当天的现场氛围，既有集会的期待与激动，也有骑兵冲入后转向恐惧与悲痛的转折。专辑以书籍形式呈现，收录同时代的信件、政治漫画与插图，构成多媒体项目。作为历史题材的英格兰工业民谣，旋律有力、叙事清晰，情感充沛，但整体仍属于传统民谣范畴，未见显著的实验性元素或跨界融合。

items._cn_summary: 这篇内容并非传统意义上的音乐评论，而是出自新书《International Freak》的节选，讲述了1970年南非裔知识分子Robin Farquharson在伦敦试图以摇滚乐为媒介发动政治革命的失败经历。他出生于1930年的南非特权家庭，战后曾参与社会改造运动，后因秘密警察监视而流亡伦敦。1970年他录制了一首献给被关押的巴勒斯坦劫机者Leila Khaled的单曲，试图将自己塑造为反文化领袖。文章侧重于这位边缘人物的历史叙事和政治背景，描述其从知识分子到摇滚歌手再到革命者的身份转变。文本为节选片段，内容较短，更多是历史传记性质而非音乐分析，对于关注实验、前卫或电子音乐的听众而言相关性较低。
